name: ceh-session-learning
description: CEH session learning: turn one Claude Code session's transcript into something durable. When the session went wrong, parallel analysts find why, every finding citing a transcript line and each root cause routed to a fix, with a scrubbed copy for sharing. When it went right, the steps that worked become a reusable SKILL.md, with the user's corrections as rules and per-run values as arguments.
